recorded.prompt:q-glpk: Answer ONLY from this question's own text: its stem and its options. Use no knowledge of the subject at all; treat every term as a word you have never met. Pick an option only when the wording itself singles it out: it is longer or more specific than the others, it repeats words from the stem, the others carry absolute terms such as 'always' or 'never', the stem's grammar fits it alone, or it restates the stem. A cue decides only when it clearly singles out one option over every other; a weak cue, or one another option shares, decides nothing. Otherwise answer 'none'. Say which cue decided it, or that none did.

recorded.prompt:q-glpk:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-glpk:a: GLPK is listed as refused/"not compiled" in this build.
recorded.prompt:q-glpk:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-glpk:b: "A refusal never comes back as a result; mathopt.solve raises before solving".
recorded.prompt:q-glpk:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-glpk:d: A refusal is "as opposed to an answer such as 'infeasible'". MathOpt raises instead.
recorded.prompt:q-wrapper-glop:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-wrapper-glop:b: "Where MathOpt's GLOP refused, the wrapper's GLOP silently dropped the integrality."
recorded.prompt:q-wrapper-glop:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-wrapper-glop:c: ABNORMAL was BOP's status. The wrapper's GLOP returned OPTIMAL.
recorded.prompt:q-wrapper-glop:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-wrapper-glop:d: GLOP returned b = 3.5487, a fractional value.
recorded.prompt:q-gurobi:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-gurobi:a: "OR-Tools 9.15 needs... GRBcopyparams, that the libgurobi130.so inside the gurobipy 13.0.3 wheel does not have".
recorded.prompt:q-gurobi:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-gurobi:b: MathOpt gave "a C++ bad_function_call that names no cause", not a license error.
recorded.prompt:q-gurobi:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-gurobi:c: SolverType lists a GUROBI member ("GUROBI refused: RuntimeError, bad_function_call").
